messages:
Priya (GlobalBank): Hi team — procurement asked if we can run a constrained POC for an air-gapped vault. Constraints: only USB delivery or scp from their hardened jumpbox, FIPS-only crypto, and they need an "apply-without-reimage" option for urgent security patches. Can Redwood support?

Nina (AM): Short answer: yes, with minibundles + signed manifests. Need to confirm signing policy and rollback.

Jordan (SE): We'll supply two artifact types: full bundle (initial deploy) and minibundle deltas (runtime or weight patches). Minibundles include a manifest that lists ordered ops and pre/post checksums.

Maya (Eng): Technical details: minibundle = tar.gz with files + manifest.json + detached signature (.p7s). Manifests use sha256 and include base_bundle_hash to validate patch lineage. Deltas are encoded as binary patches for runtime libs and shard diffs for model weights.

Sam (Infra): Delivery flows: USB tarball labeled with bundle id and fingerprint; SCP to approved jumpbox using our pushed public cert. We'll include verify.sh (POSIX, only openssl & sha256sum) and apply.sh that creates a snapshot before applying.

Leah (Security): Key rules: private keys never leave HSM. If customer wants to sign, we hand over unsigned bundle + signing tool they run behind their HSM. Audit: apply.sh emits an append-only audit record with local sig and bundle id. FIPS mode available in runtime; we'll document how to validate.

Jordan (SE): Patch modes: hotpatch (no restart, symbol hot-swap); warmpatch (rolling restart), full replace. Hotpatch only for non-model, non-kernel changes.

Priya (GlobalBank): SLA ask: they want emergency patch within 48 hours of signing for POC. Can Redwood commit?

Nina (AM): For Redwood-signed artifacts we can commit to producing and signing a minibundle within 48 hours given required inputs. If they sign, timeline depends on customer ops.

Maya (Eng): Required inputs for 48h turnaround: current full bundle hash, jumpbox SCP key fingerprint, list of allowed patchable paths, and any HSM signing policy details. Without these we may need to produce a full bundle.

Sam (Infra): Proposed USB contents: bundle.tar.gz, manifest.json, manifest.p7s, verify.sh, apply.sh, README-apply-checks.md, audit-config.yml. verify.sh will run offline checks; apply.sh will snapshot, apply delta, validate post-checks, and emit audit line.

Leah (Security): Additional constraints: kernel-affecting patches may be disallowed. Customer must pin our public key or provide their key. We'll supply an offline verification guide.

Jordan (SE): Risk mitigations: short-lived signing keys + timestamp authority, snapshot rollback path, and pre-apply dry-run option in apply.sh.

Nina (AM): Action items:
- Jordan/Maya: minibundle format + sample manifest + sample fastpatch (ETA 2 business days)
- Sam: USB packaging checklist + verify/apply scripts (ETA 2 business days)
- Leah: security checklist + offline key/signing guidance (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Nina: update SOW language for POC SLA and licensing notes

ops-bot: Reminder: include CVE reference and mitigation notes in the fastpatch sample.

Priya (GlobalBank): Thanks, I'll confirm jumpbox details and whether they prefer customer-signed bundles. Will aim to confirm today. :thumbsup:
